{{Quote|Why us, Brazzo? What have we done?''"</br>"''That black-hearted turncoat Vader! This is how he honors his deals!|Selle and Brazzo|<ref name="Vader's Quest 1">[[Vader's Quest 1|''Vader's Quest'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Selle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who, along with their [[Gender/Legends|brother]] [[Brazzo]], worked to find who destroyed of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], they were an onlooker as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Thurlow Harris]] was interrogated by the Imperial [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] over who destroyed the Death Star. After the destroyer was revealed to be [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Vader's son]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] killed Brazzo, Selle, and other onlookers. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Hold on Selle! One more moment and we are out of here!|Brazzo|<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" />}}
[[File:SelleDeath.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Selle was killed by Darth Vader.]]
Selle was the sibling of [[Brazzo]], a [[Homeworld/Legends|resident]] of<ref name="CSWE Brazzo">{{CSWECite|I|92|Brazzo}}</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Centares">{{CSWECite|I|115|Centares}}</ref> [[Centares/Legends|Centares]].<ref name="CSWE Brazzo" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> they and their<ref name="Seven">{{SW|url=news/the-not-so-magnificent-seven|text=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|int=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|brother]],<ref name="CSWE Brazzo" /> who were [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], were part of a crew working to find who had destroyed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. One of their crew, the [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] woman [[Mala Mala]], had caught [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Thurlow Harris]] on Centares. The Imperial [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived on the world soon thereafter.<ref name="Seven" />

At the then closed [[Museum of the Old Republic]] on Centares, Selle and Brazzo were onlookers as Harris was<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" /> endlessly tortured<ref name="Seven" /> and interrogated by Vader over who had destroyed the Death Star. The pilot revealed the surname, "Skywalker,"<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" /> leading Vader to realize it was his [[Reproduction/Legends|son]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Companion">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref> The Sith then began to [[Death/Legends|kill]]<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" /> all of the Centares residents<ref name="CSWE Brazzo" /> who overheard the information,<ref name="Companion" /> as he wanted to keep the news secret from the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] of the Empire.<ref name="Seven" />

After Brazzo shot an Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], the injured Selle and her brother made their escape from the museum. The two jumped off the walkway to the museum, only to be greeted by Vader. Brazzo tried to shoot him, but his shot was reflected onto Selle's chest, killing them. Their brother cradled Selle's head and pondered how this would be explained to their [[Parent/Legends|mother]], just before Vader brought his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] down on the sibling. A stormtrooper then called out to Vader, telling him he had killed the last two witnesses, but the Sith Lord informed the individual that the witnesses [[Ban Papeega]] and Mala Mala were still alive.<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Selle! Noooo! What am I going to tell mother? What am I going to say?|Brazzo, just after Selle's death|<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" />}}
Selle was a dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]]. They had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] with a white patch parted separately from the rest of their hair, similarly to Brazzo. Following their death, their brother wondered how he would tell the two's mother about it.<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" />

==Equipment==
At the museum, the Human wore tan [[Color/Legends|robes]] with a spiked silver shoulder pad, silver [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. They used a silver [[Sword/Legends|blade]].<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selle first appeared in the [[Vader's Quest 1|first issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Vader's Quest]]'', written by [[Darko Macan]] and illustrated by [[Dave Gibbons]]. The comic was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" /> on [[February 17]], [[1999]].<ref name="DarkHorse-1">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/97-600/Star-Wars-Vaders-Quest-1-of-4|text=Star Wars: Vader's Quest 1}}</ref>
